description: Assemblyman David DiPietro (R,C-East Aurora), Sen. George Borrello (R,C-57th Senate District) and Gainesville Town Supervisor David Granger honored the legacy of Technical Sergeant Walter W. Shearing by dedicating a portion of State Route 19 in his name. As a proud son of Wyoming County who gave his life during the Battle of the Bulge, T Sgt. Shearing represents the very best of America.“It was a privilege to help ensure T Sgt. Shearing’s courage and sacrifice are never forgotten,” said DiPietro
title: DiPietro Leads Ceremony to Memorialize Local WWII Hero
